comment: Independent restore.c getlev() rest_stairs() witness: a debug Knight genocides the i and j classes, level-teleports to the open, lit Kni-loca (Home 3), leaves for Home 4 and returns, so getlev() restores the saved level. Restoring reverses the stairway list, as rest_stairs() re-adds each saved stairway with stairway_add(). The hero then searches with the m prefix until random generation finds no unseen spot and makemon_rnd_goodpos() falls back to the first stairway whose rn2(2) succeeds, which places the new monster on the down stairs; without the reversal the same draws choose the up stairs.
